lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: Gone six. You slept in it.

lines.speaker: Kit
lines.text: I wasn't sleeping. I was driving.

lines.speaker: Kit
lines.text: There was a white car right behind me.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: You were drooling on the wheel.

lines.speaker: Kit
lines.text: There was someone in the back.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: There's a parcel shelf back there, and a wet patch.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: You need a new door seal, that's all.

lines.speaker: Kit
lines.text: I saw her in the mirror.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: Old cars give you bad dreams. They've been places.

lines.speaker: Dee
lines.text: Not yet. Let's see where they go first.
